podcasts.name: Tech Snippets Today with Joseph Raczynski
podcasts.title: Deeds, Dollars & Code: How Asset Tokenization is Rewiring the Economy with Jason Powell
podcasts.description: For centuries, high-value ownership has been trapped behind a wall of clunky legal paperwork, illiquid secondary markets, and gatekept syndications. If you owned a piece of the Empire State Building, you were married to that asset for seven to ten years—whether you liked it or not. That reality is dissolving. Ernst & Young projects that asset tokenization could unlock a $30 trillion market by 2030, transforming everything from private equity to commercial real estate into programmable, liquid digital securities. Beneath the hood, blockchain provides the ledger, but stablecoins are quietly becoming the transactional bloodstream—the programmable medium of exchange not just for human investors, but for autonomous AI agents executing machine-to-machine settlements. Now that Capitol Hill has essentially voted down the landmark Clarity Act, the regulatory fog still lingers a bit. We have moved away from 'regulation by enforcement' toward perhaps clearer agency rules, but this isn’t iron clad. Joining us today Counselor Powell is here to break down what is truly at stake, how institutional deals are being re-architected on-chain, and what the future of ownership actually looks like.
